items.headline: 中国将扩大创新药医保覆盖
items.headline_en: China plans wider insurance coverage for innovative drugs
items.summary: 国家医保局表示，将优先支持癌症、慢性病、罕见病和儿童疾病创新药。2018年以来，已有199种创新药进入国家医保目录。
items.summary_en: China plans wider insurance coverage for drugs targeting cancer, chronic and rare diseases, and childhood illnesses. Since 2018, 199 innovative drugs have entered the national list.

items.headline: 国际扫盲日迎来60周年
items.summary: 联合国教科文组织将于9月8日至9日在墨西哥举行全球纪念活动。该组织估计，全球仍有至少7.39亿人缺乏基本读写能力。
items.summary_en: UNESCO will hold the global event in Mexico on 8 and 9 September. It estimates that at least 739 million people worldwide still lack basic literacy skills.

items.headline: 8月制造业PMI回升至49.8
items.headline_en: China's manufacturing PMI rises to 49.8 in August
items.summary: 指数比7月上升0.6个百分点，但仍低于50的荣枯线。生产指数为50.4，新订单指数为50.6，就业指数为48.7。
items.summary_en: The index rose 0.6 points from July but remained below the 50 mark. Production reached 50.4, new orders 50.6 and employment 48.7.

items.headline: 东北太平洋风暴活动高于常年
items.headline_en: Storm activity in the eastern Pacific is running above average
items.summary: 截至9月3日，该海域已出现15个命名风暴和6个飓风；同期大西洋有5个命名风暴，尚无飓风。
items.summary_en: By 3 September, the eastern Pacific had recorded 15 named storms and six hurricanes. The Atlantic had five named storms and no hurricanes.

items.headline: 活细胞可以反复“报告”基因活动
items.headline_en: Living cells can repeatedly report their gene activity
items.summary: MIT团队让细胞把RNA装入类病毒颗粒并释放到培养液中，无需杀死细胞，就能连续追踪基因表达变化。
items.summary_en: The team engineered cells to release RNA in virus-like particles. Researchers can then track gene activity over time without killing the cells.

source.name: 麻省理工学院新闻办公室（MIT News）

items.headline: 安东内利从第19位发车赢得意大利大奖赛
items.headline_en: Antonelli wins at Monza after starting 19th
items.summary: 安东内利因引擎处罚从第19位起步，最终反超队友拉塞尔夺冠。拉塞尔落后3.857秒获得第二，维斯塔潘排名第三。
items.summary_en: Kimi Antonelli started 19th after an engine penalty and passed teammate George Russell to win. Russell finished 3.857 seconds behind, with Max Verstappen third.

source.name: 世界一级方程式锦标赛（Formula 1）

previous_answers.headline:
六个人中，为什么一定能找到三位熟人，
或三位互不认识的人？
previous_answers.headline_en: Why must six people contain three mutual acquaintances or three mutual strangers?
previous_answers.explanation:
任选一人 A。其余五人中，至少有三人都认识 A，或至少有三人都不认识 A。

若 A 认识 B、C、D，其中任何两人认识，就与 A 组成三位熟人；若三人之间无人相识，B、C、D 就是三位陌生人。若 A 不认识 B、C、D，其中有两人互不认识，他们与 A 组成三位陌生人；否则 B、C、D 彼此认识。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Choose any person A. Among the other five, at least three all know A, or at least three all do not.

If A knows B, C and D, a connected pair among them gives three mutual acquaintances with A. If there is no such pair, B, C and D are mutual strangers. If A knows none of them, an unconnected pair gives three mutual strangers with A; otherwise B, C and D all know one another.

previous_answers.headline:
单位长绳随机剪两刀，
三段能围成三角形的概率是多少？
previous_answers.headline_en: A unit string is cut at two random points. What is the probability that the three pieces form a triangle?
previous_answers.explanation:
设两刀位置为 0 < x < y < 1，三段长度为 x、y - x、1 - y。三段能成三角形，当且仅当每段都小于 1/2。

所有 (x, y) 构成面积为 1/2 的三角形。满足 x < 1/2、y > 1/2、y < x + 1/2 的区域面积为 1/8。因此概率为 (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Let the cuts be 0 < x < y < 1. The pieces have lengths x, y - x and 1 - y. They form a triangle exactly when every piece is shorter than 1/2.

All possible pairs (x, y) fill a triangle of area 1/2. The region satisfying x < 1/2, y > 1/2 and y < x + 1/2 has area 1/8. The probability is therefore (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4.
previous_answers.subject: 上周概率题

previous_answers.headline:
北滘镇一个工作日，
大约会有多少单外卖？
previous_answers.headline_en: Roughly how many food-delivery orders are placed in Beijiao on a weekday?
previous_answers.result: 约 5 万单 / 工作日
previous_answers.explanation:
一组假设：北滘工作日常住及通勤人口约25万，其中60%会用外卖；这部分人平均每周点2单，按5个工作日均摊。

25万 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 6万单。再用约1800名活跃骑手、每人每天25单核对，得到4.5万单。因此可估为约5万单，合理范围是4万到6万单。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
One set of assumptions: about 250,000 residents and commuters are in Beijiao on a weekday; 60% use food delivery and place two orders per working week. This gives 250,000 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 60,000 orders.

A cross-check using 1,800 active riders at 25 orders each gives 45,000. A reasonable estimate is therefore about 50,000, with a range of 40,000 to 60,000.
